items.claim: Kyle Prepolec is very tough, hard to get out of there, and has great heart and determination.
items.quote: he's a tough son of a [__] He is hard to get out of there. He has the heart, he has the determination, he has the grit.

items.claim: Kyle Prepolec took his previous fight against Benoît Saint-Denis on short notice.
items.quote: he took that fight on short notice against a top-ranked guy in Benoît Saint-Denis

items.claim: Mateusz Rebecki is less aggressive in terms of grappling and submission threats compared to Benoît Saint-Denis.
items.quote: I don't think Mateusz Rebecki is as, you know, aggressive, like I said, in terms of the grappling and the submission threats that he has.

items.claim: Kyle Prepolec is durable and his chin and submission defense are not major concerns.
items.quote: Kyle Prepolec is durable. I don't worry about his chin. I don't worry too much about his submission defense.

items.claim: Kyle Prepolec benefits from having a full training camp going into this fight.
items.quote: especially with the full camp going into this.

items.claim: Mateusz Rebecki is extremely durable and very difficult to finish or get out of there.
items.quote: Mateusz Rebecki is basically impossible to kill. I mean, you have to get out of there. You got to kill him to literally get him out of there.
